BETWEEN:-
 JITENDRA DWIVEDI S/O SHRI LALJI DWIVEDI, AGED  ABOUT 32 YEARS, OCCUPATION:

AGRICULTURIST R/O  VILLAGE JAMUI POLICE STATION AMILIYA DISTRICT  SIDHI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI FALGUN YADAV - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  S TA T I O N AMILIYA DISTRICT SIDHI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI S. K. GUPTA - PANEL LAWYER )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.219/2023, dated 19.4.2023, registered at Police Station- Amiliya,
District-Sidhi (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 498A, 304-B/ 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibtion Act, 1961.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 6.10.2023 passed in M.Cr. C. No.41141/2023.

As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this second bail application too under Section 439 of Cr.P.C too filed on behalf of applicant - Jitendra Dwivedi is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Jitendra Dwivedi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71200709/
